svg.title: Saurabh Pathak — AI Engineer · Full-Stack Developer
svg.desc: Scattered particles fly together to spell Saurabh Pathak, a light sweeps across the letters, then they drift away and assemble again. Below: I build agents that act on real systems: MCP servers, RAG measured with evals, human-gated tools.
